description: 身體不舒服或受傷，前往診所、醫院或藥局說明症狀。包含描述症狀與發生經過，簡單說明過去病史，向保險公司或醫護人員解釋情況。

sentences.en: Doctor, I've been having a persistent headache and feel nauseous since yesterday.
sentences.zh: 醫生，從昨天開始我就一直頭痛，而且覺得噁心想吐。
sentences.tips: 海外就醫時，清楚說明症狀和持續時間，如 I've had a fever for two days，幫助醫生更快做出診斷。

sentences.en: I see. Have you taken any medication for it?
sentences.zh: 我明白了。你有吃任何藥嗎？
sentences.tips: 就醫時清楚說明過敏史：I'm allergic to... 及目前用藥 I'm currently taking...，幫助醫生避免處方錯誤。

sentences.en: I took some painkillers, but they didn't really help. I also feel a bit feverish.
sentences.zh: 我吃了一些止痛藥，但沒什麼用。我還覺得有點發燒。
sentences.tips: 海外就醫時，清楚說明症狀和持續時間，如 I've had a fever for two days，幫助醫生更快做出診斷。

sentences.en: Let me check your temperature and blood pressure. Do you have any allergies or existing medical conditions?
sentences.zh: 讓我量一下你的體溫和血壓。你有任何過敏或既有的健康問題嗎？
sentences.tips: 海外就醫時，清楚說明症狀和持續時間，如 I've had a fever for two days，幫助醫生更快做出診斷。

sentences.en: I'm allergic to penicillin. And I have high blood pressure, but it's under control with medication.
sentences.zh: 我對盤尼西林過敏。還有我有高血壓，但一直用藥物控制得很好。
sentences.tips: 就醫時清楚說明過敏史：I'm allergic to... 及目前用藥 I'm currently taking...，幫助醫生避免處方錯誤。

sentences.en: Thank you. It sounds like it could be a mild infection. I'm going to prescribe you some antibiotics that are safe for you.
sentences.zh: 謝謝。聽起來可能是輕微感染。我開一些對你安全的抗生素給你。
sentences.tips: 海外就醫時，清楚說明症狀和持續時間，如 I've had a fever for two days，幫助醫生更快做出診斷。

sentences.en: Will I be able to fly home in two days?
sentences.zh: 我兩天後還能飛回家嗎？
sentences.tips: 海外就醫時，清楚說明症狀和持續時間，如 I've had a fever for two days，幫助醫生更快做出診斷。

sentences.en: You should be fine if you rest and stay hydrated. I'll also give you a note for your travel insurance.
sentences.zh: 如果你多休息、多喝水，應該沒問題。我也會給你一張證明，供旅遊保險使用。
sentences.tips: 出發前確認旅遊保險的 coverage（保障範圍），就醫後保留所有收據，回國後再申請 reimbursement（理賠）。

sentences.en: I think I sprained my ankle while walking.
sentences.zh: 我想我走路時扭傷了腳踝。
sentences.tips: 海外就醫時，清楚說明症狀和持續時間，如 I've had a fever for two days，幫助醫生更快做出診斷。

sentences.en: I have a rash on my arm that's very itchy.
sentences.zh: 我手臂上有一片很癢的皮疹。
sentences.tips: 海外就醫時，清楚說明症狀和持續時間，如 I've had a fever for two days，幫助醫生更快做出診斷。

sentences.en: The pain started suddenly last night.
sentences.zh: 疼痛是昨晚突然開始的。
sentences.tips: 海外就醫時，清楚說明症狀和持續時間，如 I've had a fever for two days，幫助醫生更快做出診斷。

sentences.en: I'm currently on medication for diabetes.
sentences.zh: 我目前正在服用糖尿病藥物。
sentences.tips: 就醫時清楚說明過敏史：I'm allergic to... 及目前用藥 I'm currently taking...，幫助醫生避免處方錯誤。

sentences.en: Is there a pharmacy that's open late nearby?
sentences.zh: 附近有營業到很晚的藥局嗎？
sentences.tips: 海外就醫時，清楚說明症狀和持續時間，如 I've had a fever for two days，幫助醫生更快做出診斷。

sentences.en: I need a medical certificate for my insurance company.
sentences.zh: 我需要一份給保險公司的醫療證明。
sentences.tips: 海外就醫時，清楚說明症狀和持續時間，如 I've had a fever for two days，幫助醫生更快做出診斷。

sentences.en: Could you explain the dosage instructions to me, please?
sentences.zh: 可以請您向我解釋用藥劑量說明嗎？
sentences.tips: 提出要求時，Could you...? 或 Is it possible to...? 比直接命令（Fix this!）更禮貌，也更容易獲得正面回應。

vocabulary.example_en: She has a persistent cough that won't go away.
vocabulary.example_zh: 她有一個持續不退的咳嗽。

vocabulary.example_en: The bumpy car ride made me feel nauseous.
vocabulary.example_zh: 顛簸的車程讓我覺得噁心。

vocabulary.example_en: I have a severe allergy to nuts.
The doctor said it's just a minor throat infection.
vocabulary.example_zh: 醫生說只是輕微的喉嚨感染。

vocabulary.example_en: The doctor prescribed antibiotics and plenty of rest.
vocabulary.example_zh: 醫生開了抗生素並要求充分休息。

vocabulary.example_en: Be careful not to sprain your wrist.
What's the correct dosage for this medicine?
vocabulary.example_zh: 這種藥的正確劑量是多少？

grammar_highlights.title: 描述症狀：部位、感覺、持續時間
grammar_highlights.description: 清晰地告訴醫生症狀發生的部位（如 chest, throat）、感覺（如 sharp pain, dull ache）以及持續了多久。
grammar_highlights.example_en: I've had a dull ache in my lower back for three days.
grammar_highlights.example_zh: 我的下背部已經隱隱作痛三天了。

grammar_highlights.title: 說明過敏史與慢性病
grammar_highlights.description: 這是看診時最重要的資訊之一，務必主動告知醫生你已知的過敏原（如 penicillin）和慢性病（如 hypertension）。
grammar_highlights.example_en: I should mention that I'm allergic to sulfa drugs.
grammar_highlights.example_zh: 我應該說明我對磺胺類藥物過敏。

grammar_highlights.title: 詢問用藥指示與保險文件
grammar_highlights.description: 拿到處方藥時，確認用法（frequency）、劑量（dosage）和注意事項（precautions）。同時記得索取醫療證明（medical certificate）以便保險理賠。
grammar_highlights.example_en: Should I take this medication before or after meals?
grammar_highlights.example_zh: 我應該飯前還是飯後服用這種藥？
